words.gloss: having taken upon oneself or borne

literal: Blame having borne attained wealth-than, noble people's extreme poverty indeed foremost.
translation: To the noble, extreme poverty is far better than wealth acquired by bearing blame and disgrace.
modern: பழியை ஏற்றுக்கொண்டு அடைந்த செல்வத்தை விட, சான்றோர்களுக்கு மிகக் கடுமையான வறுமையே மேலானது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of maintaining purity of action. It states that for virtuous and noble people (சான்றோர்), living in extreme poverty (கழிநல்குரவு) is far superior (தலை) to acquiring wealth (ஆக்கம்) through shameful or disgraceful deeds (பழிமலைந்து). The word 'மலைந்து' means bearing or taking upon oneself, indicating that one should not accept blame just to gain material wealth. True nobility values honor and ethical conduct over ill-gotten riches.
